subject: 2023 Pride Events and Youth Service Program
overview: Hosts discussed the upcoming 2023 Medford Pride schedule with committee members and reviewed the AM to PM summer youth program with Reverend Wendy Miller Olapade.

items.title: Review of 2022 Pride Events
items.summary: Planning committee members Sian McDormand and Michael Lowe reviewed the city's first city-sponsored Pride events, noting high attendance at the drag show and flag raising.

items.title: 2023 Medford Pride Planning
items.summary: The committee announced a focused 2023 schedule featuring a flag raising on June 1st and a Community Pride Day at City Hall on June 25th.

items.title: AM to PM Youth Service Program
items.summary: Reverend Wendy Miller Olapade introduced the AM to PM program, which offers high school and middle school students leadership training and community service hours during the summer.
